baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-II verb at word 1 governs the qari'ah at word 4 through bi-, with Thamud and Aad as the denying subjects.
baseline_models.mechanism: The communities assign falsehood to what confronts them, while the denied noun combines an impacting blow with a warning capable of checking its hearer. Denial is therefore already a collision between a verdict of falsehood and a forceful summons, not a neutral lack of information.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or report false supplies the subjects' active verdict against the qari'ah.
One thing striking another gives the denied noun a concrete impact-body rather than leaving it an abstract proposition.
A warning that strikes and restrains makes the impact simultaneously communicative and corrective.

changed_reading.before: Thamud and Aad simply disbelieved in a named catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: They actively pronounced false a warning whose very mode is to strike, so the verse stages denial as resistance to an incoming corrective impact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of kadhdhabat and al-qari'ah permits two martial branch images to interact inside the focus construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A k-dh-b branch tests whether a charge carries through or fails, while a q-r-a branch supplies reciprocal combat. Their denial can thus be carried as a countercharge against the qari'ah: they meet the announced blow with opposition, but their charge is the one that fails to prove true in action.

activation_trace.role: A charge proves true by being carried through and false by failing, turning denial into a performative test.
Meeting blow with blow supplies the contest in which the deniers' countercharge is tested.

changed_reading.before: The verb records an inward or verbal disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The verb also profiles a failed counter-move: the peoples try to answer the qari'ah's challenge, but their opposition cannot carry through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Aad is unambiguously the proper name at word 3, yet its supplied split inventory also exposes return, timed recurrence, and counted counterpart images beside that proper-name branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without retranslating the name, Aad can act as a latent hinge: the named people carry an echo of return and counted recurrence into the object they deny. Alongside Thamud as a paired counterpart, the qari'ah becomes potentially recurrent or appointed rather than only a single undifferentiated blow.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch keeps Aad as the literal referent and prevents the latent resonance from replacing the syntax.
Return after departure and repetition after a beginning supplies a recurrence echo within the name.
The non-dominant mapped root contributes appointed, counted recurrence rather than generic repetition.
The striking branch gives the recurrent or appointed unit the character of a blow.

changed_reading.before: The verse names two past peoples and one event.
changed_reading.after: The proper name Aad also faintly times the verse: paired peoples deny a blow that can return, recur, or arrive at an appointed count.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening fixes reality against falsehood; the later sequence pounds stable terrain flat and makes the event fall with impact and sound; the close fixes knowledge beyond doubt. These cues revise the focus conflict from two competing assertions into denial of an event whose execution is its own verification.

activation_trace.role: False attribution supplies the verdict that the surrounding sequence overturns.
Physical impact supplies the focus event's mode of self-manifestation.
Fixed correspondence with reality against falsehood establishes the frame before the denial is narrated.
Pounding and demolition until level supplies observable work performed by the denied strike.
The effect and sound of a landing turns occurrence into the audible trace of impact.
Stable knowledge after doubt closes the arc in which enacted reality defeats false attribution.

structural_cues: The three opening questions about al-Haqqah precede 69:4, while the single crushing and the occurrence sequence follow it.
The ending returns from deniers to truth and certainty, enclosing the focus denial inside a verification arc.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed truth, leveling impact, the effect and sound of landing, and certainty; I supply the arrow that execution functions as the event's proof and makes the deniers' verdict fail. A live alternative is that these are adjacent names and scenes without a single verification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The peoples reject a prediction whose truth remains verbally disputed.
changed_reading.after: They reject a reality that will argue by landing: the qari'ah verifies itself through the material trace of its blow.

context_deltas.mechanism: A force is driven toward a purpose across numbered nights and days, continuously and extirpatingly, until only hollowness and no remainder are presented. This activates the focus name's return/count resonance and changes the qari'ah from one punctual knock into an administered series whose repetition completes its work.

activation_trace.role: Counted time and recurrence supplies the latent temporal grid carried by the name Aad.
Striking one thing against another supplies the repeated unit acting across that grid.
Subduing and driving something toward a purpose makes the sequence administered rather than accidental.
The number seven begins the explicit count of the striking duration.
Eight continues and differentiates the measured duration across days.
Consecutive continuation binds the numbered intervals into one sustained operation.
Emptiness supplies the internal result left by the serial blows.
The remainder branch, under explicit negation, supplies the sequence's exhaustive endpoint.

structural_cues: Aad is repeated in 69:6 immediately before the seven-night and eight-day count in 69:7.
The sequence moves from measured duration to hollow bodies and then to the question of any remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful driving, explicit counts, consecutiveness, hollowness, and absent remainder; I infer that these are successive strokes of the focus qari'ah and let them activate the name's split recurrence inventory. The alternative is one continuous wind described temporally without any knock-by-knock model.

changed_reading.before: The qari'ah is imagined as one sudden impact.
changed_reading.after: For Aad it can be a calibrated battery of returning impacts, each interval advancing the same extirpating operation until nothing remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preserved catastrophe is made into a reminder, an ear accepts the heard material, awareness contains it in the heart, and the final reminder serves people who place themselves in protection. The qari'ah's strike therefore has a reception pathway: impact becomes memory, memory becomes inward containment, and containment can become protection; denial interrupts that conversion.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the warning false supplies the blockage at the beginning of the reception pathway.
A warning that strikes the hearer supplies a communicative purpose for the qari'ah.
A reminder that makes one remember converts the past event into a reusable signal.
Containing meaning in the heart supplies durable inward uptake rather than momentary hearing.
Listening and accepting what is heard supplies the sensory gate through which the striking warning enters.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the practical endpoint of receiving the reminder.

structural_cues: The saved vessel is immediately assigned a mnemonic purpose in 69:12.
The same reminder language returns in 69:48 just before present deniers are named in 69:49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, receptive hearing, inward containment, and protection; I infer the causal path impact to memory to protection and locate denial as refusal of uptake. The live alternative is that the qari'ah is only the warning's content, while these reception terms concern a separate sign.

changed_reading.before: Denial means holding the wrong opinion about a future event.
changed_reading.after: Denial is a failed act of reception: the warning knocks, but the hearer refuses to contain the memory that could become protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus noun's open-road or courtyard branch is activated by public exposure, removal of hiding, an adjudicative written record, its commanded reading, and account. The qari'ah becomes a public confrontation with what has been recorded: what was pronounced false returns in a form that can be displayed, read, and counted.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the earlier judgment now confronted by a record.
The open prominent surface of a road or courtyard supplies a public arena for confrontation.
Bringing something out for inspection turns the arena into an evidentiary display.
Removing concealment ensures that the displayed record cannot retain a hidden compartment.
A written fixing that entails judgment gives the public evidence binding force.
Reading or recitation vocalizes the record and creates a sound-echo with, but not a root identity to, the focus qari'ah.
Counting and account supplies the procedure by which the displayed record is resolved.

structural_cues: The sequence moves directly from universal exposure in 69:18 to a book held out and read in 69:19, then to account in 69:20.
The consonantal-near echo q-r-ayn/q-r-hamza is kept as an activation cue rather than collapsed into one root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an open-place focus branch, exposure, deconcealment, binding writing, reading, and account; I supply the arrow that these form one public evidentiary procedure and use the distinct q-r-ayn/q-r-hamza echo as a bridge. The alternative is that the open-place branch and the sound echo are accidental while only the physical blow is active.

changed_reading.before: The qari'ah is only a destructive event denied in the past.
changed_reading.after: It is also the public return of evidence: the denied matter opens into a record that is exposed, voiced, and reckoned before its subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unusual lot-drawing branch of q-r-a becomes functional when names are fixed in records, books are received on opposed sides, accounts are computed, and shares are divided. On this reading the qari'ah does not merely hit everyone alike; it is the decisive event that sorts and assigns divergent outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Casting lots and drawing shares supplies a selection-and-allocation potential inside the focus noun.
Entering a name in a register or group supplies the classified population to be assigned.
The right hand and right side mark one concrete destination of the allocation.
Reckoning supplies a non-random basis for the resulting share.
The left side supplies the opposed destination and makes the sorting visibly binary.
Separating a share and dividing a whole reinforces allotment as the event's distributive function.

structural_cues: The right-book scene and left-book scene are parallel alternatives separated by their receiving side and consequence.
The account lies between the two scenes, making the division adjudicative rather than arbitrary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lot-drawing, registration, right/left reception, account, and division; I infer that the qari'ah can name the decisive allocation event. This does not infer randomness: the account is a live alternative mechanism for why the shares differ, while the primary alternative remains a blow followed by a separate judgment scene.

changed_reading.before: The qari'ah is a common blow whose only function is destruction.
changed_reading.after: It can also be the decisive sorter: an impact that opens the reckoning and assigns each recorded person to a divergent share.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending tests the provenance of a spoken message: messenger's utterance, neither poetry nor hidden-news performance, delivered from above, and not fabricated speech. This revises the focus denial into a metalinguistic act. Thamud and Aad do not only reject an event; they misclassify the status and source of the warning that announces it.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a person or report false supplies the act of source rejection.
The striking warning supplies the message whose provenance is disputed.
Messenger and message establish a transmission relation rather than anonymous speech.
Utterance in speech gives the warning an audible linguistic vehicle.
Poetry and poet supply one rejected classification of that vehicle.
A soothsayer claiming hidden reports supplies the second rejected source classification.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies the asserted direction of transmission.
Saying or attributing what did not occur supplies the explicit counterfeit alternative against which the message is tested.

structural_cues: The repeated 'not the speech of' construction presents competing source labels before affirming delivery.
The hypothetical fabrication and its immediate consequence make provenance a tested relation, not a decorative aside.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messenger, utterance, rejected poet and soothsayer labels, delivery, and counterfeit attribution; I infer that the focus act of takdhib includes misclassification of the warning's source. The alternative is that 69:4 concerns only the event's content and the later source defense addresses a separate audience problem.

changed_reading.before: The two peoples deny that the catastrophe will occur.
changed_reading.after: They also deny by relabeling the transmitted warning: takdhib is a dispute over who is speaking, what kind of speech this is, and whether its striking claim has a true source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ancient case is made a present reminder, then known deniers are identified among the current addressees with the same k-dh-b root. This activates return in the name Aad at the level of role rather than translation: the old denial-pattern comes back in new bearers, making 69:4 a recurring diagnostic type.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch preserves Aad as the historical people whose case supplies the pattern.
Return and doing again supply the latent temporal relation between ancient and present deniers.
The historical false-attribution establishes the role that can recur.
A reminder that causes recollection transfers the old case into present use.
Disclosure to the knower makes the present recurrence identifiable rather than hypothetical.
The same false-attribution branch names deniers among the current audience and completes the return of the role.

structural_cues: The surah moves from named past deniers in 69:4 to second-person reception and then to deniers 'among you' in 69:49.
The reminder statement immediately precedes the identification of present deniers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a historical proper name, reminder, present knowledge, and repetition of the denial root; I infer that the role returns and let the name's return branch resonate without retranslating Aad. The alternative is straightforward historical analogy with no activation inside the proper name.

changed_reading.before: The verse closes a report about two extinct peoples.
changed_reading.after: The verse installs a repeatable role: Aad's denial returns whenever a present hearer reenacts the same false attribution toward the striking reminder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the obligation or urging branch of k-dh-b normally belongs to a construction not present in 69:4, so it must not be rendered as the verb's direct lexical gloss. It remains worth carrying because the exact focus root supplies that branch, the focus qari'ah can be a restraining warning, and 69:34 diagnoses condemnation through failure to urge feeding. Downstream prose should qualify it as a functional afterimage: denial withholds the social impulse that a received warning should generate.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The activation attaches to kadhdhabat at word 1 and the warning branch of al-qari'ah at word 4, while leaving the ordinary takdhib syntax intact.

activation_trace.role: The formula of obligation or urging supplies an exploratory action-pressure inside the denial root.
A warning that strikes and restrains supplies the pressure that should have redirected conduct.
Trusting assent supplies the reception state explicitly absent from the condemned person.
Urging toward an act supplies the missing outward motion that makes denial socially legible.
Feeding another gives the withheld urging a concrete relational target.

changed_reading.before: Denial is exhausted by saying or believing that the qari'ah is false.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial also appears as withheld mobilization: the warning fails to become even an urge that moves another person toward feeding the vulnerable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-materializes two remote focus branches: denial as a deceptive patterned surface and qari'ah as stripping or bareness. It remains anchored in both focus words and gains a coherent sequence from exposure, removal of covering, and concealment of truth in 69:18 and 69:50. Downstream prose should present it as an image-model, not claim that either focus word literally means garment or uncovering here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The model joins the deceptive-appearance branch of kadhdhabat at word 1 to the stripped-exposure branch of al-qari'ah at word 4.

activation_trace.role: A patterned cloth that deceives by its appearance supplies denial with a misleading outer surface.
Bareness, stripping, and exposed disgrace supply the qari'ah's counteraction against that surface.
Bringing something out for sight supplies the stage on which the deceptive surface is tested.
Removing hiddenness supplies the first motion of stripping away the denial's cover.
Uncovering and removing a screen supplies the completed exposure that also becomes regret.
Concealing truth supplies the cover whose removal reveals what denial had hidden.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an invisible mental stance, and the qari'ah is external force.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial is a deceptive covering and the qari'ah is the blow that strips it, leaving the denier publicly bare before the truth it concealed.

strongest_changes: The qari'ah became self-verifying reality: its landing and material trace defeat the deniers' false verdict.
Aad's split inventory was activated twice without replacing the proper name: as a timed series of impacts and as the return of the denier-role in a present audience.
The striking warning acquired a reception mechanism in which hearing becomes memory, inward containment, and possible protection.
Exposure, written record, reading, and account turned the denied event into a public evidentiary confrontation.
The lot branch remained live as a contained model of decisive, account-based allotment into right and left outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse is unusually productive because one proper name carries return/count branches and the q-r-a inventory ranges from blow and warning to public surface and lot. The context does not collapse those possibilities: it supplies repeated force, receptive hearing, adjudicative display, source-testing, and present repetition, allowing several causal readings to coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The return and count activations in Aad may be experimental resonance rather than intended wordplay; the proper-name reading remains primary.
The q-r-ayn/q-r-hamza sound bridge to public reading keeps the roots distinct, but its salience may be accidental.
The allotment branch explains sorting but must not imply random judgment where the context supplies account.
The withheld-urging and stripped-cover models are branch-distant image mechanisms and require explicit qualification.
